entities.description: An elderly woman with long, straight gray hair sits on a beige couch, wearing a light pink cardigan over a white t-shirt and beige pants. She holds a black smartphone in both hands, looking at the screen with a wide-eyed, open-mouthed expression of shock or surprise, while a man's hand points at the phone from the left.

A young man with curly brown hair and a short beard sits on a beige couch, wearing a blue and white plaid flannel shirt over a white t-shirt and blue jeans. He is smiling broadly with an excited expression, pointing at a smartphone held by a person next to him.

clothing.shirt: blue and white plaid flannel, unbuttoned

attributes.pose: sitting, pointing with right index finger
attributes.action: looking at a smartphone held by another person

entities.description: A close-up view of the back of a black smartphone held in a person's hand, featuring a square camera module in the top-left corner with three lenses arranged in a triangular pattern and a flash. The phone has a matte finish and rounded corners, with fingers gripping the lower portion of the device.
